title: Elon sent his car to space (AE-style demo Short)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2018, Elon Musk launched the most powerful rocket flying anywhere on Earth.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And instead of a satellite, he put his own car on top.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: See, new rockets usually carry a block of concrete. Elon said that was boring.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So he sent his cherry red Tesla, with a dummy in a spacesuit at the wheel.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Before launch, he said he'd call it a win if it just didn't blow up the launch pad.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two boosters came back and landed side by side, at the exact same time.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The third one missed the ship and slammed into the ocean. Hey, two out of three.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the car? It's still out there, looping around the Sun.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Honestly, the most expensive car ad in history.
